description: Instafan helps groups decide where to go — together. Ask for a mood and get real destination suggestions, pull a live brief on any city (weather this month, official safety verdict), see its strongest Google-rated places with real photos right in the chat, and get a day-by-day plan built from them. Nothing is invented: every place is a real, rated spot. One link carries the trip into instafan.app, where your whole group can immerse in 3D, save spots, and vote.

defaultPrompt: Where should we go in November from Portland — somewhere warm with adventure?
